about: Public-sector bargaining units (unions come with 1.0; the smallest bargaining is a unit contract at the budget date). A unit is the town's jobs at one public employer class. Its contract passes the growth of the employer's own budget line, per worker, to the unit's pay: the line each class is paid from is named here. The employer's level of government comes from public-pay-floor.json; a class paid from a line its own level does not budget is paid from the nearest government above that does. Where the bargaining law is not in force at the employer's level or above, there is no contract.
